────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 Factory reset: not available yet

 Factory reset is available after hardware test H7: no record of it for the ProtoArc EM11 Pro (7B04) on firmware v1.00.

 Hardware test H7 sends the reset once to a mouse with this firmware, after a verified full backup, and records what it
 clears and whether the mouse stays paired. Until that record exists for this model and firmware, arcctl does not send
 it.

 To put settings back now, select a backup and press w. The vendor web app can reset the mouse too: take a full backup
 here first (f), and see "Re-pairing without arcctl" in docs/safety.md in case the mouse needs pairing again.
